scope: Bounded local model two-pass single-card review; not independent human approval.

cards.title: Relief Is Suspicious
cards.instruction: Treat every reassuring development as evidence that the real threat has merely changed shape.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The inspection passed? That's suspiciously convenient.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They found nothing wrong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the problem has become good at hiding.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They checked everything twice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Whatever escaped that deserves a more serious inspection.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our restaurant passed inspection? Even the grease trap?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Spotless. I had it pumped out. Can I start cooking?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So the trouble's moved into the tanker. Is it still outside?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's sealed. Nothing can escape.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we've bottled it under pressure beside our diners. Ask the driver to leave before I unlock the doors.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 makes a clean inspection evidence of concealment; A5 treats thoroughness as proof of greater danger.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's 'nothing wrong' produces A3's hiding theory; B4's double check produces A5's escalation.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 defend the inspection, but B has no concrete stake in accepting its result.

heightening.evidence: A5 demands a more serious inspection because B4 establishes that ordinary checking was thorough.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes an inspection but never identifies the inspected place, object, or practical decision.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's problem becoming 'good at hiding' economically converts reassurance into threat.

cardFidelity.evidence: B2's cleaned grease trap becomes relocated trouble in A3; B4's sealed tanker becomes concentrated danger in A5. Both reassurances change the threat's shape.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 takes the tanker specifically from B2's pumping; A5 converts B4's seal into pressure. The pressure inference is suspicious character logic, though physically unestablished.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants permission to start cooking; A5 makes opening the restaurant conditional on removing the tanker, giving A's suspicion a workplace consequence.

heightening.evidence: A3 asks where the displaced trouble is; after B4, A5 treats containment as a danger to diners and delays opening.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a restaurant inspection and grease trap; B2's cooking request and A5's locked doors make the immediate task playable.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's trouble moving into the tanker and A5's 'bottled it under pressure' express one economical suspicious logic.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 says the trap was pumped out; A3 locates the supposedly surviving trouble in the tanker.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers a sealed container as reassurance; A5 interprets that seal as dangerous pressure and requires its removal.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A3 and A5 repeatedly reinterpret successful mitigation as transformed danger.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 escalates A3's suspicion into a condition affecting opening and diners.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A treats reassuring inspection and containment results as evidence that the restaurant's threat has migrated and become concentrated.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: General pessimism anticipates failure; this card turns successful cleaning and secure containment into affirmative evidence of a transformed threat.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 uses B2's successful pumping to locate danger in the tanker; A5 uses B4's sealed containment to imagine pressure beside diners.

records.recommendedEdit: The rejected candidate left the inspection unspecified and B without a practical stake. The new illustrative restaurant setting gives B cooking to begin and makes A's suspicion affect opening. Separate internal reread under coach-1.0: fidelity 5, A3 and A5 transform successful safeguards into danger; logic 4, B2 causes relocation and B4 causes the pressure inference; relationship 4, B2 needs permission to cook and A5 adds an opening condition; heightening 4, A5 makes containment threaten diners; specificity 5, A1 and B2 establish restaurant preparation; brevity 4, A3's relocated trouble develops the cleaning detail economically. Total 88. Five spoken ABABA turns and all hard gates pass on internal reread.
records.remainingConcern: The tanker being under pressure is A's inference rather than an established fact. It remains readable as sincere suspicion. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A5's pressure inference is A's anxious interpretation, not an established property of a sealed tanker; sincere concern must carry that leap.
records.alternativeComparison: The preserved alternative turns committee acceptance and personal support into surveillance. This candidate uses operational reassurance and A's authority over opening a restaurant.

cards.title: Relief Is Suspicious
cards.instruction: Treat every reassuring development as evidence that the real threat has merely changed shape.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You say the neighbours liked my speech. What are they preparing me for?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They just enjoyed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why tell you rather than me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They told you too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Coordinated reassurance. That's what concerns me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The neighbours liked my speech? I thought they'd vote me off the committee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've asked you to chair next month's meeting. Please say yes; I'm exhausted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So they're keeping me where they can watch me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll sit beside you and handle complaints.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They've given me a minder. Will you be reporting my mistakes to them?

cardFidelity.evidence: A5 converts direct praise into 'coordinated reassurance,' but A3 mainly questions how praise was delivered.

responseLogic.evidence: B4 directly corrects A3 and causes A5; B2 does not establish A3's assumption that neighbours avoided A.

relationship.evidence: B2 reassures and B4 corrects, but B has no purpose beyond disputing A's suspicion.

heightening.evidence: A5 expands an individual concern into coordinated behaviour after B4 confirms multiple direct reassurances.

specificity.evidence: A1 identifies neighbours and a speech, giving the exchange an immediately understandable social setting.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'Coordinated reassurance' succinctly repurposes B4's correction.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 reinterprets promotion as surveillance; A5 reinterprets B's protective assistance as appointment of a minder.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's chair invitation supplies A3's watched position; B4's seat beside A supplies A5's suspected reporting arrangement.

relationship.evidence: B2 says 'I'm exhausted,' giving B a reason to recruit A; B4 offers to absorb complaints to secure agreement.

heightening.evidence: A5 brings the imagined surveillance into the immediate relationship by asking whether B will report mistakes.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes neighbours, a speech and committee membership; B2 specifies next month's chairing duty.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'where they can watch me' and A5's 'minder' efficiently corrupt two distinct reassuring developments.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: The invitation to chair in B2 becomes the mechanism for keeping A observable in A3.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers proximity and complaint handling; A5 converts those specific protections into monitoring.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: Each helpful development supplies A with a new shape for the feared committee rejection.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 implicates the helpful B personally instead of suspecting only absent neighbours.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A treats each reassuring social development as evidence that exclusion has changed into surveillance.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Ordinary insecurity doubts praise; this card uses praise and assistance as positive evidence of a newly shaped threat.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Revised A3 turns B2's invitation into surveillance, and A5 turns B4's supportive presence into supervision.

records.recommendedEdit: The revision gives B a concrete need and makes each offer change the imagined threat. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, logic 5, relationship 4, heightening 4, specificity 5, brevity 4 = 92. B4's offer to sit beside A specifically causes A5's minder inference. The committee setting is newly illustrative.
records.remainingConcern: No rewrite needed. A5 makes the suspicion explicit, leaving slightly less interpretive room for performance.
records.writerReservation: The surveillance interpretation is deliberately extreme; A needs to play it as a sincere protective inference rather than a knowing accusation.
records.alternativeComparison: Unlike a's repeated inspection logic, b turns recruitment and practical support into escalating distrust within a working relationship.

cards.title: Rescue Me by Needing Me
cards.instruction: Take protective control, then let each consequence reveal how much your confidence depends on remaining necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me fix your bike before you ride. I know which bolts matter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've tightened them already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll check the checking. There must be something left.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can just come riding with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Without a repair to do? Give me a minute to remember how.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me fix your bike before you ride. I know which bolts matter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've tightened them already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll check the checking. There must be something left.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can just come riding with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Without a repair to do? Give me a minute to remember how.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims protective expertise; A3 searches for remaining work; A5 loses assurance when usefulness disappears.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's completed tightening causes A3's checking; B4's invitation without work causes A5's hesitation.

relationship.evidence: B4 offers companionship instead of dependence, materially changing how A can participate.

heightening.evidence: A5 exposes the insecurity beneath A1's confident intervention after B4 removes the repair role.

specificity.evidence: A1's bike and bolts establish a concrete pre-ride situation actors can play immediately.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'check the checking' earns its absurdity through B2's completed maintenance.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 claims protective mechanical expertise; A3 searches for remaining work; A5 loses confidence when companionship requires no rescue.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's completed tightening causes A3 to invent checking the check; B4's riding invitation exposes A5's dependence on repair work.

relationship.evidence: B2 asserts competence and B4 offers shared recreation, giving A a credible route into equal companionship.

heightening.evidence: A5 moves from redundant checking in A3 to admitting difficulty participating without a useful task.

specificity.evidence: A1's bike, bolts and imminent ride establish an immediately playable protective intervention.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'check the checking' is economical; A5's 'remember how' carries vulnerability with a small ambiguity.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 removes the bolt-tightening job, causing A3 to manufacture a supervisory job.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers participation without maintenance, causing A5's uncertainty about joining without a repair.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: Protective authority in A1 progressively reveals dependence on being necessary in A3 and A5.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: The consequence shifts from unnecessary work to A's ability to accept ordinary companionship.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A takes charge of B's safety, then reveals increasing uncertainty as B removes the need for rescue.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Simple controlling behaviour preserves authority; this card exposes confidence that depends on another person's dependence.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3's 'There must be something left' and A5's difficulty accepting an ordinary ride reveal need beneath the expertise.

records.recommendedEdit: Both partner turns cause a distinct response, and the helpful B4 produces the clearest revelation of A's dependence. Internal rereading confirms the original passes unchanged.
records.remainingConcern: No rewrite needed. 'Remember how' could briefly suggest forgotten cycling skills rather than uncertainty about equal companionship.
records.writerReservation: A5 is slightly literary, and its heightening is emotional exposure rather than a larger protective intervention.
records.alternativeComparison: Alternative a lets usefulness fall away into vulnerable companionship; b tries to convert celebration into another service assignment.

cards.title: Rescue Me by Needing Me
cards.instruction: Take protective control, then let each consequence reveal how much your confidence depends on remaining necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle the difficult phone call for you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've made it. It went well.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There may be a follow-up only I can manage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather celebrate with you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could the celebration require help setting up? I'm better when useful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me your landlord's number. I'll get your deposit back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Already done, Mum. I'm taking you out to celebrate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me book. You still need someone who checks the reviews.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked your favourite. Just bring yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not even a cake? Could you forget your reading glasses? I could read you the menu.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 takes over difficulty; A3 invents exclusive follow-up work; A5 admits being steadier when useful.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's successful call causes A3's follow-up claim; B4's celebration causes A5's setup request.

relationship.evidence: B4 actively asks for shared pleasure, offering A a relationship beyond managing problems.

heightening.evidence: A5 carries the need to be necessary into B4's problem-free celebration.

specificity.evidence: A1's 'difficult phone call' leaves its recipient and stakes unspecified.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's request that celebration require help efficiently converts B4's solution into the same dependency.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 takes protective control of the deposit dispute; A3 retreats to checking reviews; A5 asks for manufactured dependence once B4 removes that job.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's completed recovery and dinner invitation produce A3's booking offer. B4's completed booking and 'Just bring yourself' produce A5's search for another useful role.

relationship.evidence: B2 identifies A as Mum and wants to celebrate with her; B4 offers her favourite restaurant while gently removing her managerial role.

heightening.evidence: A3 still claims a legitimate checking function; A5 openly asks B to forget glasses so A can remain necessary.

specificity.evidence: A1's landlord deposit, B2's 'Mum,' and B4's favourite restaurant establish a clear parent-child situation with immediate playable stakes.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'Could you forget your reading glasses?' compactly reveals the need beneath A1's confident rescue offer.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 removes the deposit problem and introduces dinner, so A3 switches protection to restaurant selection.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 removes booking responsibility and requests A's presence alone; A5 invents a menu-reading dependency.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1's confident protection becomes A5's exposed need to be useful.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 moves from finding existing needs to asking B to create one.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A takes protective control as a parent, then manufactures progressively smaller dependencies as B demonstrates competence and offers care.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Ordinary parental helpfulness responds to an actual need; this card reveals confidence faltering when A must invent a need to retain a role.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 replaces the completed deposit rescue with protective booking; after B4 completes that too, A5 asks B to manufacture dependence by forgetting glasses.

records.recommendedEdit: The rejected candidate's unspecified call and explanatory admission become a concrete deposit recovery and an embodied request for artificial dependence. The parent-child restaurant celebration is newly illustrative. Separate internal reread under coach-1.0: fidelity 5, A1's takeover shrinks to A5's invented need; logic 5, B2 removes recovery work and B4 removes booking work; relationship 5, B2 and B4 actively offer care to Mum; heightening 4, A5 asks B to become less capable; specificity 5, A1 identifies a deposit and B4 a favourite restaurant; brevity 4, A5's glasses request shows the insecurity without naming it. Total 95. Five spoken ABABA turns and all hard gates pass.
records.remainingConcern: A5 exposes the dependency unusually explicitly, but the request remains sincere and playable. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: The request to forget glasses makes the dependency unusually visible; A should offer it hopefully rather than as a calculated joke.
records.alternativeComparison: The preserved bike alternative accepts companionship with uncertainty. This mother-child alternative actively bargains for a small continuing rescue role.

cards.title: Belonging on Changing Terms
cards.instruction: Seek acceptance by adapting quickly, then let each adaptation create a new version of yourself you must defend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I bought the formal jacket you said would fit in at the club.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tonight's casual.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll become someone who wears a formal jacket casually.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can take it off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not immediately. I've only just learned what kind of member this makes me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I bought this jacket for my first supper at your sailing club. Will I fit in?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're casual. Roll your sleeves up; I'll introduce you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There. I'm one of those relaxed old hands.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Lovely. I'll tell them you're new so they'll explain things.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say I'm returning. You can explain the boats privately. These sleeves suggest I already know.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 buys acceptance through dress; A3 invents a revised identity; A5 defends that newly acquired membership identity.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's casual dress code causes A3's reinterpretation; B4's removal suggestion threatens the identity defended in A5.

relationship.evidence: B1 is absent, but A1 establishes B as the adviser; B4 then offers a practical route out of the problem.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes removing a jacket a threat to the kind of member A has just become.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a club visit and a purchased formal jacket, though the club remains unnamed.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's plan to wear a formal jacket casually follows directly from B2's correction.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 seeks club acceptance; A3 converts B2's casual sleeves into an experienced identity; A5 defends that identity against B4's helpful introduction.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 directly uses B2's rolled sleeves. B4 proposes announcing A's newness, causing A5 to request 'returning' and private explanations.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers introductions and B4 offers beginner assistance; A5 negotiates how this helpful insider may present A.

heightening.evidence: A3's casual self-description becomes A5's request for a misleading history and concealed instruction after B4 threatens the persona.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a first sailing-club supper and a purchased jacket; B2 makes the adjustment physically clear through spoken dialogue.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'These sleeves suggest I already know' earns its absurdity from the exact clothing adjustment in B2.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 recommends casual sleeves; A3 immediately adopts them and an accompanying old-hand identity.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 would publicly establish A as new; A5 protects the newly adopted identity by changing the introduction.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: Acceptance-seeking adaptation in A3 generates the identity A must defend in A5.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 expands a clothing adjustment into a claim about experience and conditions on B's help.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A adapts dress to win acceptance, then protects the experienced social identity created by that adaptation against B's helpful introduction.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Simple bluffing conceals ignorance for advantage; this card makes the bluff emerge from an adaptation undertaken to belong.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: B2's rolled-sleeve advice creates A3's relaxed old hand, and B4's proposed newcomer introduction makes A5 negotiate to preserve that new self.

records.recommendedEdit: The rejected candidate ended in abstract identity defense with little investment from B. The newly specified sailing-club supper gives B an introduction to manage and A a concrete concealment tactic. Separate internal reread under coach-1.0: fidelity 5, A3's adapted identity requires A5's defense; logic 5, B2 supplies sleeves and B4 supplies the threatening introduction; relationship 4, B offers social guidance and an easier welcome; heightening 4, A5 asks B to misrepresent experience and tutor privately; specificity 5, A1 establishes the first club supper; brevity 4, A5's sleeves carry the mistaken claim to expertise. Total 92. B4 directly causes the request to be called returning. Five spoken ABABA turns and all hard gates pass.
records.remainingConcern: Only one adaptation is fully developed; the inference from casual dress to experience is deliberately large. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A5 edges toward status bluffing, but the initial acceptance request and B's dress advice keep the identity defense grounded in adaptation.
records.alternativeComparison: This alternative negotiates public status with a helpful club insider. S233-single-b repeatedly changes identity to preserve a friendship and manage a sister's impression.

cards.title: Belonging on Changing Terms
cards.instruction: Seek acceptance by adapting quickly, then let each adaptation create a new version of yourself you must defend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You wanted a more adventurous friend, so I've booked us climbing lessons.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant trying a new cafe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Well, I'm a climbing person now. I've told my sister.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Cancel the lessons.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And become unreliable as well? I'm trying to keep one identity long enough to belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You wanted a more adventurous friend, so I've booked us climbing lessons.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant trying a new cafe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Well, I'm a climbing person now. I've told my sister.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Cancel. I need a friend who listens.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'm a listener. Will you tell my sister I listened to you, rather than gave up climbing?

relationship.evidence: B2 wants a modest shared outing and B4 resists being committed to climbing lessons.

specificity.evidence: A1's booked climbing lessons and A3's announcement to a sister make the commitment concrete.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'one identity long enough to belong' explains the card after the sharper reliability objection.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 adapts to the requested adventurous friend; A3 defends becoming a climbing person; A5 adopts 'listener' while seeking protection for that new identity.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 corrects the scale of adventure, prompting A3's defence. B4 explicitly requests listening, which A5 adopts and asks B to validate to the sister.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants a modest shared outing; B4 asserts a need to be heard. A5 makes B responsible for explaining A's adaptation to another person.

heightening.evidence: A3 invokes an existing announcement to the sister; after B4, A5 recruits B to reconcile the replacement identity with that announcement.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's immediate 'I'm a listener' and distinction between listening and giving up make the comic turn follow A3's identity investment.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 says the intended adventure was a cafe; A3 defends the already announced climbing identity against that correction.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 names listening as the friendship requirement; A5 instantly adopts that identity and asks B to defend its meaning to the sister.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1, A3 and A5 show acceptance pursued through successive identities that acquire reputational obligations.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 requires B's participation in defending the latest adaptation, extending A3's private claim.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A rapidly adopts identities to meet B's friendship needs, then recruits B to defend the public meaning of each adjustment.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Sunk-cost reluctance resists wasting a booking; this card makes A protect and replace social identities rather than the money or activity.

cards.title: Humility with Evidence
cards.instruction: Perform modesty while planting small facts that can later assemble themselves into undeniable proof of your importance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The roof practically fixed itself. My ladder was only there six weekends.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You did a lot of work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nothing worth mentioning, beyond the invoices I've arranged by date.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why are your initials on every page?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So the evidence doesn't embarrass us by becoming inaccurate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For the hall minutes, just say the roof's repaired. My six weekends aren't worth recording.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Good. I'm keeping the minutes to one page.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: These dated invoices can go separately. My initials only show who paid.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put them in the accounts folder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. A tiny footnote will do: accounts, pages one to forty. No need to name me twice.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 minimizes six weekends of labour; A3 plants dated invoices; A5 disguises attribution as factual accuracy.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's credit produces A3's denial plus records; B4's initials question causes A5's accuracy defence.

relationship.evidence: B2 willingly recognizes A, while B4 challenges why further attribution has been engineered.

heightening.evidence: A5 defends the systematic initials exposed by B4 while preserving the modest pose.

specificity.evidence: A1's roof and six weekends, followed by A3's dated invoices, supply concrete playable evidence.

brevityWit.evidence: A1's self-fixing roof and six-weekend ladder plant the contradiction economically.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 dismisses six weekends while mentioning them; A3 supplies dated, initialled payment evidence; A5 quietly links the minutes to forty pages of proof.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's one-page limit causes A3 to propose separate invoices. B4's accounts folder gives A5 the precise destination for a footnote.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants concise minutes and B4 files supporting material appropriately; A adjusts the route to recognition around B's practical decisions.

heightening.evidence: A3's apparently administrative initials become A5's extensive documentary trail, accessed through a supposedly tiny footnote after B4 files it.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes hall minutes and a repaired roof; A3's invoices and B4's accounts folder make the evidence-planting concrete.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'tiny footnote' leading to 'pages one to forty' earns its disproportion through the invoices introduced in A3.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 restricts the minutes to one page; A3 relocates the evidence to separate supporting documents.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 selects the accounts folder; A5 requests a footnote pointing readers there.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A consistently disclaims importance while arranging discoverable evidence of labour and financial contribution.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 makes the evidence accessible from the official record while retaining the language of modest restraint.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A performs restraint about public credit while placing an attributed documentary trail where it can establish the scale of A's contribution.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: A direct boast announces importance; this card hides an accumulating proof of importance inside modest requests about record keeping.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A1 dismisses six weekends while supplying them, A3 offers dated initials under a payment pretext, and A5 links the public minutes to forty pages.

records.recommendedEdit: The rejected candidate already received praise and ended by defending existing initials. The newly illustrative hall-minutes setting gives B a one-page limit and lets A engineer future discovery of the evidence. Separate internal reread under coach-1.0: fidelity 5, A1, A3 and A5 accumulate modestly presented facts; logic 5, B2's page limit causes separate invoices and B4's filing choice causes a cross-reference; relationship 4, B has a credible editing constraint and filing solution; heightening 4, A5 reveals forty pages and seeks their public pointer; specificity 5, A1's hall minutes and A3's paid invoices establish the work; brevity 4, A5's tiny footnote exposes a large contribution without requesting praise. Total 92. B4 specifically supplies the folder A5 wants cited. Five spoken ABABA turns and all hard gates pass.
